method: bounded static AST inspection, no candidate imports or execution; metadata only; categories are heuristic triage, not a claim of line-by-line audit
scope_notes: Canonical /private/tmp and /private/var/tmp only; /tmp and /var/tmp aliases deduplicated.
Current user macOS session temp root included.
Shallow immediate /Users/bengamble directory-name scan found no tmp/temp/scratch/.tmp directories; no unrelated home/data recursion.
Named dependency/vendor trees excluded; known scratchpad/dl/zstd and dl/lz4 downloads excluded on refined pass.
One inventory-tool script authored during mining is included as generated_mining_tool, not an extraction source.
Snapshots are observational. Directories may have changed concurrently; timestamps delimit actual pass.
